businesses.business: Natural gas utilities and energy services

offering_description.value: New Jersey Resources distributes natural gas through its regulated New Jersey utility and supplies wholesale gas to utilities and other energy buyers. It also operates gas pipelines, storage facilities and solar projects, and installs and services heating, cooling and other home equipment.

primary_products.value: Natural gas; solar electricity; renewable energy certificates; heating and cooling equipment; water heaters and standby generators

primary_services.value: Natural gas distribution; pipeline transportation; underground gas storage; wholesale gas supply and portfolio management; home equipment installation and repair

customer_segment.value: B2C: Households buying natural gas or home equipment and maintenance; B2B: Commercial and industrial gas users, utilities, gas marketers, power generators and electricity buyers

end_markets.value: Residential and commercial gas utility service; wholesale natural gas; pipeline transportation and storage; solar power; residential HVAC and home services

revenue_model.value: product sales: Retail and wholesale natural gas, solar electricity, renewable energy certificates and home equipment; transaction or usage fees: Metered gas delivery and reserved or used pipeline and storage capacity; service fees: Home equipment installation, maintenance and repair
revenue_model.category: product sales; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: distributor: Delivers purchased or customer-supplied natural gas to homes and businesses through local mains; asset operator: Operates gas pipelines and storage for shippers and solar facilities that sell electricity to power buyers; service provider: Manages gas supply and capacity for wholesale customers and installs and services equipment for homeowners; retailer: Sells heating, cooling and other home equipment directly to households
value_chain_position.category: distributor; asset operator; service provider; retailer

geography_served.value: North America: New Jersey utility and home services, U.S. pipeline, storage and solar operations, and wholesale gas activity in the U.S. and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Regulated gas distribution, wholesale gas supply, pipelines and storage, solar generation and home equipment services

distribution_channels.value: other: Local utility mains and meters deliver gas to homes and businesses; direct sales: Wholesale gas, pipeline and storage agreements, power offtake agreements and direct bookings for home equipment and service

regulatory_exposure.value: high: New Jersey Board of Public Utilities oversees retail gas rates, and FERC regulates interstate gas pipeline and storage tariffs.

notes: The current mix of owned solar projects is uncertain.
